'''Heiko Bellmann''' (17 March 1950 – 7 March 2014) was a German [[biologist]], writer, [[zoologist]] and photographer. He published over fifty books.

Bellmann died on 7 March 2014 at the age of 63.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.swp.de/ulm/lokales/ulm_neu_ulm/Uni-Biologe-Heiko-Bellmann-gestorben;art4329,2491486|title=Uni-Biologe Heiko Bellmann gestorben|newspaper=[[Südwest Presse]]|date=10 March 2014|accessdate=11 March 2014|language=de|archive-date=10 March 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140310231236/https://www.swp.de/ulm/lokales/ulm_neu_ulm/Uni-Biologe-Heiko-Bellmann-gestorben%3Bart4329%2C2491486|url-status=dead}}</ref>
